about.license: Free and open source. Runs entirely in your browser.

confirmTrash.sub: Off by default. Undo is always offered.

hidden.sub: Names that start with a dot.

cmd.label: Command palette
cmd.placeholder: Type a command or search files

coach.tip1Body: Every file has the same actions in its menu.
coach.tip2Body: Drop files or folders anywhere in the list.
coach.tip3Body: Search looks at file names in this bucket.

conf.all: {count, plural, one {Apply to this conflict} other {Apply to all # conflicts}}

keep.sub: The new file is saved as {name}.

replace.sub: The new file overwrites the old one.

conf.title: This file already exists

bulk.body: {count, plural, one {This # item will} other {These # items will}} be deleted from {bucket}. You can’t undo this.
bulk.hint: Large deletes need the count typed in.
bulk.title: {count, plural, one {Delete # item forever?} other {Delete # items forever?}}

empty.body: {count, plural, one {The # item in Trash will be deleted forever.} other {All # items in Trash will be deleted forever.}} You can’t undo this.
empty.title: Empty trash?

one.body: {name} will be deleted from {bucket}. You can’t undo this.
one.title: Delete forever?

err.slash: Names can’t contain slashes. Use Move to change folders.

drop.title: Drop files to upload them to “{folder}”

emptyBucket.body: Upload your first file, or drag a folder in. Folders are created from file paths.
emptyBucket.title: {bucket} has no files yet

emptyFolder.body: Drag files here, or use New to upload files or create a folder.
emptyFolder.title: This folder is empty

error.body: The bucket didn’t answer in time (timeout after {seconds} s). Your files are not affected.
error.title: Couldn’t load this folder

partial.body: Load all to sort by size.
partial.title: Showing {count} items

forget.connections: {count, plural, one {# saved connection and its key} other {# saved connections and their keys}}
forget.note: Your buckets and files are not changed.
forget.title: Forget this device?

form.accountIdError: Account ID is {length} lowercase letters and digits. Copy it from the {page} page.

addr.hint: Try Path if you get a bucket-not-found error.

bucket.hint: Leave empty to pick from the buckets this key can see.
bucket.tencent: Bucket names end with your APPID.

form.endpointHostWarn: This endpoint doesn’t look like a {provider} address. Check the spelling before you connect.
form.endpointPath: Includes the path {path}. Edit only if your project uses a custom domain.

publishableKey.hint: Used as the secret in session token mode.

sessionToken.hint: The signed-in user’s JWT. Row-level security applies.

recent.note: Saved in this browser. Nothing is read from your bucket for this list.

cors.s2: Under CORS policy, choose Add CORS policy and paste the JSON.
cors.title: Your bucket needs a CORS rule
cors.warn: Don’t use * as an allowed origin. It lets any website use your bucket from a visitor’s browser.
cors.why: The browser blocked the request because {origin} isn’t allowed by this bucket yet.

ob.factKeys: Your keys stay in this browser

bucket.next: Switch the region and test again.
bucket.title: Bucket not found in this region

denied.next: Give the key read and write access to this bucket, then try again.
denied.title: Access denied
denied.why: The key is valid, but it isn’t allowed to list {bucket}.

net.next: Use an https endpoint, or run Coffer on your own machine.
net.title: Can’t reach {endpoint}
net.why: Browsers block http endpoints on https pages, except localhost.

sig.next: Re-enter the secret key. If it’s right, set your device clock to automatic and try again.
sig.title: The signature didn’t match
sig.why: The secret key may have a stray space, or your device clock is off by {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

help.scoped: Create a key limited to one bucket. It’s safer if the key ever leaks.
help.title: Where do I find these?

locked.body: It locked after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} away. Your files are safe. Enter your passphrase to continue.
locked.title: Coffer is locked

pass.body: Reads and writes work. You can start managing files.
pass.title: Connected

paste.label: Paste here
paste.privacy: The pasted text is cleared as soon as the form is filled. It isn’t stored or sent anywhere.
paste.sub: Fills the form from AWS-style environment lines, an rclone remote, or an endpoint.

pick.scope: {count, plural, one {This key can access # bucket.} other {This key can access # buckets.}} A key limited to one bucket is safer.

none.body: Most services with an S3 API work. Use the generic option and enter the endpoint yourself.
none.title: No provider named “{q}”

ro.body: You can still browse, preview and download. Uploads, renames, moves and deletes stay off.
ro.title: This key can read but not write
ro.why: The bucket refused the test file with AccessDenied.

save.body: Keep this connection on this device so you don’t enter keys again. It’s encrypted with a passphrase only you know.
save.nofix: We can’t recover this passphrase. If you forget it, you’ll add the connection again.
save.strength: Strength: good. {count} characters or more is best.
save.title: Save on this device?

test.note: Coffer writes a small test file and deletes it again. It doesn’t touch your other files.

unlock.body: Enter the passphrase you chose when you saved them.

forget.note: Forgetting removes saved connections, starred items and recent files from this browser.

unlock.label: Passphrase
unlock.title: Unlock your connections
unlock.wrong: That passphrase doesn’t match. Check for caps lock and try again.

welcome.body: Coffer is a file manager for S3-compatible storage. It runs in your browser, with no server in between.
welcome.title: Manage your bucket files the way you already manage files

interrupted.body: {done} of {total} objects in {name} were moved before the page closed.
interrupted.title: A move was interrupted

html.notice: Shown as code for your safety.

none.body: {type} files can’t be shown in the browser. You can still download the file.
none.title: No preview for this file type

svg.meta: SVG · shown as an image, scripts never run

reveal.body: Enter your passphrase to show the secret key for {name}.
reveal.note: The secret stays visible for {seconds} seconds, then hides again.
reveal.title: Show secret key

banner.body: You can browse, preview and download. To change files, connect with a key that has write access.

none.body: Search looks at names in {bucket}. Try a shorter word or remove a filter.
none.title: No results for “{q}”

autolock.sub: Locks after you’ve been away. Unlocking needs your passphrase.

sec.clipboard: Copied. Clear your clipboard when you’re done.

forget.sub: Deletes saved connections, the operation journal, starred items and recent files from this browser. Your buckets are not changed.

stored.sub: See everything Coffer keeps in this browser.

security.sub: Auto-lock after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

share.body: Anyone with the link can open this file until it expires. Links can’t be revoked early.
share.invalidate: To cancel all links early, rotate the access key at your provider.

session.body: Your token expires at {time} ({minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} from now), so longer choices are unavailable.
session.title: This link stops working when your session token expires

empty.body: Star files and folders to find them fast. Stars are saved in this browser only.
empty.title: Nothing starred yet

star.note: Saved in this browser. Starred items aren’t stored in your bucket.

idle.body: Coffer counts every object in {bucket}. On large buckets this can take a few minutes and many requests.
idle.title: Usage isn’t calculated yet

total.sub: in {count, plural, one {# object} other {# objects}} · calculated {when}

creds.sub: {count, plural, one {# connection} other {# connections}} · encrypted with your passphrase

journal.sub: {count, plural, one {# interrupted move} other {# interrupted moves}}

stored.note: Coffer sends nothing to any server except your own storage provider.

recent.sub: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · names only

starred.sub: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · not encrypted

toast.trashed: Moved {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to trash

trash.note: Trash is the {prefix} folder in your bucket. Items stay until you empty it.

resume.body: {name} stopped at part {part} of {total}. Choose the file again to continue.
resume.title: Upload paused when the page reloaded

title.failed: {count, plural, one {# upload failed} other {# uploads failed}}
